children: CoreWeave completed an upsized private placement of $4.2 billion 2.875% Convertible Senior Notes due 2033, issuing the notes under a new Indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee. The notes are senior unsecured, guaranteed by certain subsidiaries, and are convertible at an initial price of about $97.85 per share, with settlement in cash, stock, or both at the company’s election. To reduce potential dilution and manage conversion economics, CoreWeave entered $566.2 million in capped call transactions with a group of global banks, featuring an initial cap price of $199.70 per share. Net proceeds of approximately $4.137 billion will fund the capped calls and general corporate purposes.
